historical_reviews.v3_1: The acceptance object is the coupled platform envelope. CPU, memory, disk, GPU and IB loads must overlap while four PSU inputs and both BMC/OS reachability are observed; component-local success cannot hide a shared rail, cooling, PCIe/fabric or management-path failure.

original_test_intent: Validate eight-hour stability of the exact full hardware configuration and four-PSU power arrangement under simultaneous CPU, memory, disk, GPU and InfiniBand load while BMC and OS management remain continuously reachable.
original_method: Verify the full recipe and four independent approved PSU inputs, bind every CPU/DIMM/storage/GPU/IB component and peer, calibrate each bounded workload separately, then stage them into synchronized eight-hour overlap with continuous per-domain health, aggregate power/thermal and BMC/OS reachability monitoring; stop all generators together on any failure and prove full recovery.
manual_activity: Platform, GPU, storage and fabric owners approve the full recipe, PSU/feed map, all component profiles, peers/endpoints, eight-hour window, limits and recovery; operators supervise full-load behavior and judge the outcome.
required_inputs: Exact full-config BOM/recipe and firmware/driver matrix
Dedicated drained SUT and maintenance window
Serial-bound disposable disk path/range and I/O profile
GPU UUID/topology and approved stress/health tool
BMC and OS management endpoints/routes and ping cadence
Aggregate power, thermal, link, error and reachability thresholds
safety_requirements: Do not infer full configuration or PSU redundancy from presence alone
Do not select storage or GPUs by unstable enumeration
Do not generate IB traffic without approved peer and fabric isolation
Stage and calibrate domains before concurrency
Keep independent recovery outside stressed paths
Monitor per-PSU current/power, thermals, GPU XIDs, IB counters, storage and events
Stop all loads on PSU, thermal, link, I/O, GPU, reachability or evidence failure
Do not expose credentials or disable host verification
Do not auto-restart a failed domain
agent_execution_scope: Verify full recipe, four PSU feeds and all topology identities
Capture per-domain health, power, thermal, link and event baseline
Validate and calibrate approved component workloads separately
Stage workloads with synchronized overlap and reachability probes
Monitor component and shared-resource aborts continuously
Coordinate one stop boundary and preserve fault chronology
Verify final topology, management and workload readiness
engineer_actions: Approve full recipe, PSU redundancy and component workload matrix
Approve GPU/IB tools, peers, storage scope and management endpoints
Supervise staged ramp and coordinated abort decisions
Resolve power, thermal, GPU, fabric, storage or reachability anomalies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its stress-ng command covers only generic CPU/VM/HDD workers; memory bytes and disk path are undefined, GPU and IB are absent, four PSUs/full recipe and BMC/OS pings are unchecked, unsafe SSH exposes secrets and `tail` discards evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use owner-approved domain-specific CPU/memory/storage/GPU/IB workloads with serial/UUID/port-bound targets, staged calibration, a shared eight-hour supervisor, independent BMC/OS probes and synchronized full health/event capture.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full configuration, four PSUs, five simultaneous stress domains, uninterrupted BMC/OS reachability and eight hours remain exact source requirements; domain tools, targets and limits require owner input.

modernized_recommendation.status: SYNCHRONIZED FULL-CONFIG LOAD ENVELOPE WITH SHARED-FAILURE ABORT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a signed topology and workload ledger, calibrate each domain, then establish and prove a common eight-hour overlap while correlating PSU, thermal, PCIe/fabric, storage and management evidence on one clock.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes full configuration, four-feed power, cross-domain timing and continuous reachability independently auditable and recoverable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CPU/VM/HDD success alone misses GPU XIDs, IB fabric errors, PSU current sharing and management outages—the defining coverage of this case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Full simultaneous load can exceed rack/feed, PSU, VRM, cooling, PCIe, storage and fabric capacity, interrupt recovery paths and affect peers; synthetic tools may not reproduce application traffic.

project_override_considerations: Approve the exact full BOM, four PSU/feed and redundancy contract, per-domain tools/targets/load, GPU/IB peer topology, storage safety, ping interval/loss budget, common overlap tolerance and all shared/per-domain abort thresholds.
expected_evidence: Full-recipe comparison, four PSU serial/feed/status/current baseline and owner approvals
CPU/DIMM/storage/GPU UUID/IB port-peer/topology plus firmware/driver/tool identities
Calibration outputs and synchronized eight-hour workload overlap ledger
Full per-domain outputs, GPU XID/health, IB link/traffic/error, storage integrity and worker status
Continuous BMC/OS reachability timeline and PSU/power/thermal/platform metrics
Preserved OS/BMC/fabric events, coordinated abort/no-retry audit, final full-system readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, eight-hour Machine Time and Criteria consistently define a full-configuration simultaneous multi-domain load with four PSUs and uninterrupted management reachability. Missing exact tools/topology are required execution inputs, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: All named domains and success conditions are identifiable. Exact recipe, tools, targets, peers and limits can be supplied by owners, so classification is REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Restores every omitted source domain, distinguishes per-component health from the coupled full-platform envelope, and makes uninterrupted BMC/OS management plus four-PSU behavior first-class acceptance evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A full-config test probes shared bottlenecks that isolated stress cannot: GPU and IB traffic can contend for PCIe/root-complex bandwidth, all devices contribute to PSU/thermal load, and management controllers may starve during sensor/event bursts. Evidence must be time-correlated so a transient ping loss or XID can be matched to rail, temperature or fabric behavior instead of being averaged away.
